title: POST /ingest/source url adapter uses an unguarded fetcher: private/loopback/metadata targets accepted
detail: adapters.ts jinaReaderFetch calls bare fetch(`https://r.jina.ai/${url}`). Probe with stubbed global fetch: http://localhost:8080/a, http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/, http://10.0.0.5/x, http://[::1]/x, http://192.168.1.1/, http://172.16.0.1/ were all detected by the url adapter and forwarded (7/7 http targets forwarded, 0 refused). Route only checks /^https?:///. No isBlockedAddress/createGuardedFetcher (packages/ingest guarded-fetch) and no test asserts it (cf. ISS-C-UNRUN-WRITERS-017 isGuardedFetcher). Fetch is by third party Jina, so no direct local hit, but internal hostnames/URLs are shipped to a third party and the SSRF boundary is absent if the fetcher is ever swapped.
fix_direction: Pre-check host with resolveAll+isBlockedAddress before fetch (refuse with 400/422) and add a table test for localhost,127/8,10/8,172.16/12,192.168/16,169.254/16,::1,fe80::,DNS->private, redirects, file:.

title: sink.save leaves orphan rows when insertMany partially succeeds (turns, media)
detail: store.ts pushes the undo step only AFTER insertMany returns, so an ordered insertMany that inserts a prefix then throws leaves that prefix. Probe (in-memory colls, tenant t1): turns insertMany inserts 1 row then throws -> final rows sources0 media0 sessions0 turns1; media variant -> media1. Expected 0 rows. Orphan turns/media remain tenant-scoped but unreferenced and may collide on retry.
fix_direction: Push undo (delete by _id set) before the insertMany call for media and turns.
